summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on product + fintech innovation.

articles.title: How stablecoins speed int’l payments
articles.description: Startup Latitude Global pitches faster, cheaper cross-border payments by sending them on modern stablecoin rails.

articles.title: PayPal hints at BNPL holiday use
articles.description: Some consumers will turn to buy now, pay later options for holiday shopping to spread costs over time, according to a survey by the digital processor.

articles.title: Stripe swallows Parafin
articles.description: The mega processor is buying an embedded financing company that caters to small businesses, in its second acquisition in as many months.

articles.title: Fiserv’s stablecoin system starts
articles.description: The mega processor’s system for hosting digital currencies is up and running, with North Dakota’s stablecoin the first digital asset to go live.

articles.title: Will Europe unseat Visa, Mastercard?
articles.description: The Wero project launched by European banks is making progress in challenging the card networks’ dominance on the continent, but the U.S. companies still have an edge, one firm’s analysts contend.

articles.title: Circle CFO to step down
articles.description: Finance chief Jeremy Fox-Geen will leave the stablecoin issuer later this year, after ushering the company through its long-awaited 2025 IPO.

articles.title: AI shopping agents need receipts
articles.description: As artificial intelligence assumes a bigger role in commerce and finances, having a clear record of agents’ actions is critical, executives said.

articles.title: Senate passes Common Cents bill
articles.description: The measure to provide merchants a cash rounding framework, and to formally phase out the penny, now heads to the White House.
